context.person: A person using a collaborative document editor
context.user_goal: Compare the versions now or resolve the preserved conflict later.

product_state.preceding_state: Two people edited the same paragraph while one device was offline.
product_state.current_state: Both versions are preserved. The offline version has not replaced the shared version.
known_facts: The offline version has not replaced the shared version.
Choosing one version removes the other from the paragraph but keeps it in version history.
The conflict can be resolved later.
forbidden_claims: The offline edit is already published.
Choosing a version permanently deletes history.

challenge: Rewrite the decision or recovery dialog so the person can understand document edit conflict, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Compare both versions and choose one for the paragraph.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Keep the conflict unresolved and return to the document.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The shared paragraph cannot include both competing versions automatically.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Compare the versions now or resolve the preserved conflict later.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
